points.description: States that edge detection (road edges) is a useful feature, and that road edges/shadows are used to distinguish bridges and flyovers from ordinary roads.
points.partial_credit: Half credit if only edge detection / road edges named without the bridge/flyover link.

points.description: States road width as a feature for categorising roads.
States road length as a feature, specifically the length between two junctions / dead ends.
points.partial_credit: Half credit if 'length of the road' is stated without the junction/dead-end qualification.

points.description: States colour of the road (surface colour/tone) as a feature for categorising roads.

rubric.notes: Full marks need all four features named precisely: edges (with shadows/edges for bridges and flyovers), width, length between junctions/dead ends, and colour. Award a point only when the feature is stated clearly; vague answers such as 'shape' or 'size of road' earn nothing. A wrong extra feature that is not a valid image-based road feature costs the point it sits beside; a student who lists only some of the four gets only those points, rounded down to a whole mark at the end (0, 1 or 2).
